meta.parties: Sangaramorthy Et Al. v. Candappa Et Al

rules.statement: Even after a mutual will of spouses married in community of property, the survivor retains dominium over half of the common estate unless they take some benefit under the will.
rules.supporting_quote: "The act of the survivor in taking benefit under the will does not of itself pass the dominium in his half share to those to whom it has been bequeathed."
